text:
maria: Hey team — RFC followup: I'm drafting an approach that sits a read-only 'immutable registry proxy' inside customer airgap network. It serves content-addressed artifacts (tarballs/chunks), signed manifests; agents pull from it. Goals: reduce repeated transfers, simplify verification, enable dedup, and allow delta-only syncs. Thoughts?

alex: sgtm. A few thoughts: how do we handle signature rotation? we need graceful fallback when new root keys roll.

maria: Plan: manifests signed by a delegation chain. Proxy ships both current and previous signing keys (kinds of bootstrapping). Clients verify against a small trust store. Rotation uses signed rotation manifest anchored to previous key.

kevin: Question: storage cost vs bandwidth tradeoff — proxy needs to keep object store for N days. who prunes? ops or customer? Also cache eviction strategy?

sara: Recommend LRU + GC windows + admin TTL. Keep dedup by content-hash. We can surface metrics for hit-rate to console.

alex: Also need atomic apply semantics on agent. If agent pulls chunks and apply fails, we must avoid partial state. Solution: download to staging dir, verify whole manifest, then swap symlink atomically.

nate: We should support 'delta pointers' inside manifest so proxy can advertise smaller deltas first. But then client needs to recombine.

maria: ```
manifest_v2:
  id: sha256:abcd...
  parts:
    - id: sha256:111...
      size: 32MB
    - id: sha256:222...
  signatures: [sha256:sig1...]
  deltas: { base: sha256:0f1..., patches: [sha256:333...] }
```

ingrid: Security: ensure proxy cannot be used as exfil channel. restrict egress in customer network, auth via mTLS and short-lived tokens. Also KMS/HSM keywrap for private keys.

deploy-bot: deploy job #4321: registry-proxy image build passed — tags: 2026.03.20

maria: Action items: I'll add key rotation flow to RFC doc, kevin can draft GC/metrics runbook, sara to propose agent staging layout. If no objections, I'll put PR by EOD. :thumbsup:
